rare.why: DWDS: entlegen is an adjective (remote, far away)
DWDS: unterlegen = put underneath; also the adjective inferior

forms.ex: Leg das Buch auf den Tisch.
forms.exEn: Put the book on the table.

forms.en: put down; take off (a coat); take (an exam)
forms.clue: to take off (a coat); to take (an exam)
forms.ex: Ich lege im Oktober die Prüfung ab.
forms.exEn: I am taking the exam in October.
forms.why: ab = off: take your coat off and lay it down. Eine Prüfung ablegen = take an exam: learn it as a phrase.

forms.en: create (a file, an account); invest; moor
forms.clue: to create (a file); to invest (money)
forms.ex: Ich lege einen neuen Ordner an.
forms.exEn: I am creating a new folder.
forms.why: an = on: lay a new file on the pile; a boat lays itself against the quay.

forms.clue: to hang up (the phone)
forms.ex: Er legt einfach auf.
forms.exEn: He just hangs up.
forms.why: auf = onto: lay the receiver back onto its cradle.

forms.en: put in, insert; eine Pause einlegen: take a break
forms.clue: to put in; to take (a break)
forms.ex: Wir legen eine kurze Pause ein.
forms.exEn: We are taking a short break.
forms.why: ein = in: lay something into something else.

forms.clue: to present, to show (a document)
forms.ex: Bitte legen Sie Ihren Ausweis vor.
forms.exEn: Please show your ID.
forms.why: vor = in front: lay it in front of someone.

forms.en: put more on (a fire); add more
forms.clue: to put more on (the fire)
forms.ex: Ich lege noch Holz nach.
forms.exEn: I am putting more wood on.
forms.why: nach = after: lay more on after the first.

forms.en: sich etwas zulegen: get yourself something; gain (weight, speed)
forms.clue: to get yourself (a new car, sich); to gain
forms.ex: Ich lege mir ein neues Fahrrad zu.
forms.exEn: I am getting myself a new bike.
forms.why: zu = added: lay more onto what you have.

forms.clue: to think about, to consider
forms.ex: Ich überlege es mir noch.
forms.exEn: I am still thinking about it.
forms.why: über = over: turn a question over in your mind. (überlegen as an adjective means superior.)

forms.en: take (a course); prove, document (with evidence); put a topping on (a roll); occupy (a seat, a place)
forms.clue: to take (a course); to prove
forms.ex: Ich belege einen Deutschkurs.
forms.exEn: I am taking a German course.
forms.why: be- aims at a target: lay something on a surface. Ein belegtes Brötchen has something laid on it; a seat that is belegt is taken.

forms.en: move, postpone (to another time or place); misplace
forms.clue: to postpone, to move; to misplace
forms.ex: Wir verlegen das Treffen auf Freitag.
forms.exEn: We are moving the meeting to Friday.
forms.why: ver = away, off course: lay it somewhere else, on purpose or by mistake. (verlegen as an adjective means embarrassed.)

forms.clue: to take apart, to dismantle
forms.ex: Er zerlegt den alten Schrank.
forms.exEn: He is taking the old wardrobe apart.
forms.why: zer = to pieces.

forms.clue: the consideration, a thought
forms.ex: Nach langer Überlegung hat sie die Stelle angenommen.
forms.exEn: After long consideration she accepted the job.

forms.clue: the receipt; a piece of proof
forms.ex: Heben Sie alle Belege für die Steuer auf.
forms.exEn: Keep all the receipts for your taxes.

forms.clue: can be taken apart (furniture)
forms.ex: Der Tisch ist zerlegbar und passt ins Auto.
forms.exEn: The table comes apart and fits in the car.

forms.en: put down; sich hinlegen: lie down
forms.clue: to put down; to lie down (sich)
forms.ex: Ich lege mich kurz hin.
forms.exEn: I'm going to lie down for a bit.
forms.why: hin = there, away from you: you lay a thing (or yourself) down there.

forms.clue: to refute, to disprove (a claim)
forms.ex: Die neue Studie widerlegt diese Theorie.
forms.exEn: The new study disproves this theory.
forms.why: wider = against: you lay an argument against a claim until it falls.

forms.clue: to set out, to explain (your reasons)
forms.ex: Sie hat ihre Gründe ausführlich dargelegt.
forms.exEn: She set out her reasons in detail.
forms.why: dar = there, in view: you lay your reasons out before people.

forms.en: fix, set (a date, a price); lay down (rules)
forms.clue: to fix, to set (a date, rules)
forms.ex: Wir sollten einen Termin festlegen.
forms.exEn: We should set a date.
forms.why: fest = firm, fixed: you lay something down so that it stays.

forms.en: fixing, setting (of a date, a limit)
forms.clue: the fixing (of a date, a limit)
forms.ex: Die Festlegung des Termins hat lange gedauert.
forms.exEn: Fixing the date took a long time.

forms.en: interpret (a text, a law); lay out (goods); pay for someone for now (Geld auslegen); cover (a floor)
forms.clue: to interpret (a law); to lay out (goods, a floor)
forms.ex: Jeder Richter legt das Gesetz etwas anders aus.
forms.exEn: Every judge interprets the law a little differently.
forms.why: aus = out: you lay out what a text means, as you lay goods out on display.

forms.clue: the interpretation (of a law)
forms.ex: Das ist eine Frage der Auslegung.
forms.exEn: That's a question of interpretation.

forms.clue: fundamental, basic
forms.ex: Es gab grundlegende Änderungen.
forms.exEn: There were fundamental changes.
forms.why: den Grund legen = lay the foundation: what is grundlegend lays the foundation for the rest.

forms.clue: to put away (your phone)
forms.ex: Leg bitte dein Handy weg.
forms.exEn: Please put your phone away.
forms.why: weg = away: you lay it away from you.

forms.en: put back; put aside (money); cover (a distance)
forms.clue: to put back; to cover (a distance)
forms.ex: Wir haben heute zwanzig Kilometer zurückgelegt.
forms.exEn: We covered twenty kilometres today.
forms.why: zurück = back: you lay a thing back; a distance you have covered lies behind you.

forms.clue: to fold (laundry); to merge
forms.ex: Ich lege noch die Wäsche zusammen.
forms.exEn: I'm just going to fold the laundry.
forms.why: zusammen = together: you lay the parts together.

forms.clue: to enclose (in a letter); to settle
forms.ex: Ich lege dem Brief eine Kopie bei.
forms.exEn: I'm enclosing a copy with the letter.
forms.why: bei = with, beside: you lay something beside the letter; a dispute is laid to rest.

forms.clue: the side dish
forms.ex: Als Beilage gibt es Reis oder Kartoffeln.
forms.exEn: It comes with rice or potatoes on the side.
forms.why: What is laid beside the main dish. -lage nouns take the a of liegen/lag (legen itself is regular: legte), and -e makes them die.

forms.en: attachment (to a letter, an email); facility, plant; investment
forms.clue: the attachment (of an email); a facility
forms.ex: Die Rechnung finden Sie in der Anlage.
forms.exEn: You will find the invoice attached.
forms.why: What is laid on (angelegt): a page laid on a letter, a site laid out, money laid in.

forms.en: edition, print run (of a book); condition, requirement
forms.clue: the edition (of a book); a condition
forms.ex: Das Buch erscheint bald in der dritten Auflage.
forms.exEn: The book is coming out soon in its third edition.
forms.why: A book is aufgelegt (put out in print); a condition is laid on you.

forms.clue: the template (for a letter, a CV)
forms.ex: Ich nutze eine Vorlage für meinen Lebenslauf.
forms.exEn: I use a template for my CV.
forms.why: What is laid in front of you to follow or to check.

forms.en: filing (tray), filing system; shelf to put things on
forms.clue: the filing tray; a place to put things
forms.ex: Leg die Briefe bitte in die Ablage.
forms.exEn: Please put the letters in the filing tray.

forms.clue: the publishing house
forms.ex: Sie arbeitet bei einem großen Verlag.
forms.exEn: She works for a big publisher.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: verlegen also means to publish books, and der Verlag is the firm that does it.
